inputBoundary: Each isolated agent received only 12 raw English sentences and a compact instruction that exact identity is limited to canonical framed predicates; no gold Sem, expected roles, atoms, groups, or scoring metadata were supplied.
interpretation: Both agents abstained on the entire set because the supplied contract did not include enough concrete frame/term construction detail. This is not a semantic accuracy result; it exposes an adoption-surface usability gap. The contract must remain authoritative, but a future trial should provide the generated frame-first contract block rather than a summary sentence.
